Shado-Pan.content:
Shado-pan is a relatively simple and streamlined version of Windwalker to play in raids. It should excel at providing consistent pressure, lose minimal damage to mechanics, and also provide some flexible use of  Zenith to adapt to different fight timings. The main difference between this build and one looking to deal more AOE damage is that it travels fully down the right side of the talent tree to grab  Jadefire Stomp and the connected choice node.

Different from the raid build, the Mythic+ build takes more talents from the left side of the Spec tree, in order to increase the damage and add some AOE cleave to all of the  Rising Sun Kicks you'll be casting to get as much cooldown reduction on  Fists of Fury as you can.

Identical to the Mythic+ build, the Delve build for Windwalker focuses on a mix of single-target and AOE damage to adjust to the various setups of the different delves.
